method: All nine template builders were read after independent source account. Compare the displayed ODE and worked integration with 14551 steps 1–5.
observations: easy: y′-ay=b exp(rx) with r!=a, or y′-ay=x^m exp(ax), m=1 or2; direct exponential or power antiderivative after multiplication.
moderate: n/x coefficient with constant or exp(rx)/x^n forcing; x>0 and simple logarithmic IF followed by direct integration.
hard: sine/cosine forcing with exactly x times trig after multiplication, or derivative normalization followed by one linear-times-exponential IBP.
All question-bank families and the target canonical cosine case are supported. Adjacent transforming-only and initial-value examples belong to other KPs and are not imported.
Small bounded coefficients/rates keep the workload comparable. No nonlinear ODEs, special functions, extra response fields or initial conditions are introduced.
